changes.title: Train the press more: more Out Of Possession weeks
changes.why: For a gegenpress side the press is the identity, but your press isn't biting hard enough: tackles won 14th of 20; this season you've run In Possession weeks 0×, Out Of Possession 0× and Balanced 5×, so Pressing Intensity and Pressing Trap come round about 6.0× a week.
changes.do: Alternate Tactical Focus – In Possession and Tactical Focus – Out Of Possession week to week (or use Balanced in weeks with two matches), so Pressing Intensity, Pressing Trap and Out Of Possession Shape come up every week.
changes.safe: It swaps which tactical sessions you do, not how many — same three sessions a day, same match rhythm, same load. You keep In Possession every other week, so the attacking work isn't dropped.

keep: Aggression is low across your XI (13.7), but you're already 13th of 20 for fouls — training it team-wide would add fouls and cards. Only give it as an individual focus to players who are also poor at winning the ball back.
Shots (2nd of 20): constant pressure on goal — don't take out the sessions behind it.
Opponents' final-third passes (1st of 20): keeping teams pinned back — don't take out the sessions behind it.
xG against (3rd of 20): opponents barely get a sniff — don't take out the sessions behind it.
Goals conceded (1st of 20): hard to score against — don't take out the sessions behind it.
